instruction: Use Abaqus to perform a static tensile analysis of a thin rectangular shell plate with a central circular hole (Variant A). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system. Model Definition: Create a 3D Deformable Shell planar part. Sketch a rectangle from (0, 0) to (160, 80) in the X-Y plane. Sketch a circular hole at the plate center (X = 80, Y = 40) with a diameter of 16 mm. Material and Section: Define a material named Steel with Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa and Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3. Create a Homogeneous Shell Section with a thickness of 1.2 mm and 5 through-thickness integration points, and assign it to the entire plate. Assembly: Create one dependent instance of the plate. Analysis Step: Create a Static, General step named Step-Tension-A with small-displacement analysis and nonlinear geometry turned off. Loads and Boundary Conditions: Apply U3 = 0 to all plate nodes to keep the shell in the X-Y plane. At the bottom-left corner node located at (X = 0, Y = 0), constrain U1 = U2 = 0. At the bottom-right corner node located at (X = 160, Y = 0), constrain U2 = 0 only. Apply a tensile edge load of 12 N/mm to the left and right vertical edges as equivalent nodal forces after meshing. On the X = 0 edge, apply nodal forces in the negative X direction. On the X = 160 edge, apply nodal forces in the positive X direction. For each loaded edge node, calculate the nodal force as 12 N/mm multiplied by that node's tributary edge length. Discretization: Mesh the plate with a global seed size of 10 mm and a local seed size of 4 mm on the circular hole edge. Assign S4R shell elements and generate the mesh. Job Execution: Create a job named Job-Hole-A, submit it for analysis, and wait for the analysis to complete successfully. Post-Processing: Review the von Mises stress field. Record the maximum von Mises stress and verify whether it occurs near the circular hole. Deliverables: Save the model database as C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Hole-A.cae and ensure the output database is written to C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-Hole-A.odb. Run the solver to completion and ensure a result file is generated.
